- **New hard compile blocker: `RequestAction.outcome: ActionResult`** (`DomainModels.swift:438-450`) — `RequestAction` declares `Codable` and `Equatable`, but `ActionResult` (line 134) conforms to neither. Synthesized `Codable`/`Equatable` on `RequestAction` will fail to compile because one of its stored properties isn't `Codable`/`Equatable`.
